Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children

WIC provides healthy foods, personalized nutrition education, breastfeeding support, and referrals to other services. It serves women who are currently pregnant, recently pregnant, or breastfeeding, and babies and kids under 5.
